title: 15 Periods of Bible History
extractionNotes: Text is preserved as written in the source slides, including spelling, punctuation, capitalization, and historical claims.
description and sourceMemoryText are source text, not revised historical commentary.
memoryScene and historicalExplanation split the original narrative at the phrase “This represents” when present.
Images are not embedded in this JSON.

bibleBooks is supplemental content added after extraction; it is NOT from the source PPTX. It is a conventional mapping of Bible books to periods, and dating of some books (e.g. Job, Joel, Obadiah, Psalms) is debated. Period 13 has no books.

importantPeople is supplemental content added after extraction; it is NOT from the source PPTX. Entries marked biblical:false (period 13) are historical figures from outside the Bible. Placement of some figures (e.g. Job, Joel, Nimrod) is debated, and many people span more than one period.
sourceAttribution: This information was created from a PTP session that Stephen Haschke attended in 2015.  It was originally presented by Monte Ginnings.
